column1: # What the wasm build replaces in vendor/alchemy (pinned 24b72a32) and why (orchestrator D3). Vendor files are
# never edited or copied: a replaced header is taken over by port/shim/prelude.h (its include guard), a replaced
# C file is left out of the build and our own file takes its place.
# kind: header = shim header; transform = the vendor file is rewritten at build time by tools/wasm/port_src.py
# (generic rules: nested functions -> clang blocks, port/asm_rules.tsv) into build/, never into our tree;
# asm = vendor assembly routine replaced by our C (D6). status: done | todo
